title: Prominence on 30A Just One Life Prominence on 30A
meta_description: Prominence Just One Life - Pet Friendly, Golf Cart, 4 Bikes, Beach, 2 Pools
description_expanded: AboutProminence 30A pet friendly rental, Just One Life, located in Watersound, Florida by Panhandle Getaways is a 3 bedroom, 2.5 bathroom vacation home complete with all of the conveniences of home. Golf cart included with your stay. Traveling with a pet? Upon arrival, your pup will receive a Posh Pet Gift Pack filled with fun, beach-ready goodies. Each pack also includes a Posh Pet Photo Contest card to share a photo of your furry friend enjoying their new gear and bandana. Sunshine, sand, and tail-wagging adventures await! Free Activities Included. see details below*** FEATURES * 3 Bedroom 30A Townhome * Golf Cart Included * PET FRIENDLY*** * Large Living Area - 70" TV * Fully Equipped Kitchen with Breakfast Bar * Brand New Refrigerator with 2 Ice Producing Compartments * Bedroom 1 - King Bed , 50" TV, En Suite Bathroom * Bedroom 2 - Queen Bed, 50" TV * Bathroom 2 - Tub/Shower Combo * Bedroom 3 - Full Bed & Bunk Bed (T/T), 24" TV * Living Area - Queen Sleeper Sofa * Full-Size Washer/Dryer * Additional Full Size Refrigerator in Garage * Private Deck with Tree View * 6 Beach Chairs and Beach Toys Included * Beach Towels Included * 8 Bikes Included - 2 Adolescent Size * Complimentary High Speed Wi-Fi * Sleeps 10 Surveillance device located on outside of property NOTE: The owner's bikes, beach gear, and beach towels are included but not guaranteed. Should any item become lost or broken making them unavailable to use, there will be no refund as the use provided is at the courtesy of the owner. PET FRIENDLY WITH STIPULATIONS** We welcome well trained, non-shedding, non-aggressive breeds of dogs to stay in this home. We require that your dog be completely potty trained and prefer dogs older than 2 years old. Crate Trained pups are preferred to deter mischievous behavior while you and your party are enjoying the beach. It is understood that while we do allow dogs with the mentioned stipulations any damages that occur during your stay will be charged to the credit card on file with the minimum fee being $350.00. ADDITIONAL PET FEE APPLIES & IS COLLECTED AFTER BOOKING IS MADE. About Prominence on 30A - Watersound, Florida Prominence is one of the most popular communities on 30A and features incredible amenities, open green spaces and easy access to over 17 miles of bike paths. Prominence is perfectly located to new and long time 30A haunts as well as the beautiful white beaches of Scenic 30A. Guests will enjoy a beautiful town center and 2 resort style pools. Located at the town center, the Big Chill is a hot-spot for entertainment and features an outdoor 25 ft LED theater screen for sporting events and movie nights on the green. Concerts, family activities, restaurants, and boutique shops are just some of the things to do within a less than 5 minute walk. Prominence is centrally located on 30A between Seagrove and Seaside to the west and Alys and Rosemary Beach to the east. COMMUNITY and THE BIG CHILL AMENITIES Walking distance to The Big Chill - Restaurants and Pubs, Boutique Shops and Nightly Entertainment Onsite Ice Machine Kids Movie Nights and Sports Viewings at the Hub 2 Large Community Pool(s) with Zero Entry (no steps) – perfect for the elderly and toddlers Barbecue Areas Proximity to the amenities at Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach and Seaside 5 miles to nearest Grocery Store ***Guests receive 1 free daily admission to some of our favorite local attractions through our partnership with Xplorie. All perks are valid for stays up to 27 days and are subject to change and availability. BONUS PERKS INCLUDED WITH YOUR STAY: * 1 FREE Round of Golf at 1 of 4 Golf Courses in the area Every Day - Year Round * 4 Bikes - Ready to Go at the Home - Year Round * 1 FREE Voucher to use for an unforgettable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel trip Each Day! (Mar-Oct) Please note: Pool heated seasonally is subject to change at any time by the HOA for the community. Panhandle Getaways is not responsible for any change in seasonal heating of the one pool in Prominence. No refunds for any change to pool heated seasonally. Beach Accesses for ALL Prominence homes are via South Walton public beach access points. Most Prominence guests utilize Deer Lake State Park beach access or other nearby public beach accesses. Prominence homes do not have direct beach access via Watersound Club nor do they have access to Watersound private club facilities. INITIAL SUPPLIES - UPON ARRIVAL Panhandle Getaways furnishes a few essential items for guests to utilize until they can get to the grocery store. Initial Supplies include: Dishwasher soap, small washing machine powder, each bathroom has amenities (like hotel but NOT restocked) shampoo, conditioner, soap bar. One roll of toilet paper in each bathroom & one paper towel roll in the kitchen. All bed linens and towels are provided. We encourage guests to bring beach towels for use at the pool and beach.
